service_preference.when: 값 없는 단순 켜/꺼 명령 (모드 enum에 off 없음)
service_preference.source_quote: On/off (켜/꺼, no value) → `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off` (the AC carries `Switch`; the mode enum has NO "off").

service_preference.when: 켜짐/꺼짐 상태 조건 확인
service_preference.source_quote: "켜져 있으면"(on/off state) → `Switch.Switch`, NOT `AirConditionerMode`.

unstructured: 상대적 온도 변경("1도 낮춰")은 TargetTemperature를 읽은 뒤 SetTargetTemperature로 쓰는 read→write 체인 (같은 디바이스 내) — 원문: "A relative change (\"1도 낮춰\") reads `TargetTemperature` then `SetTargetTemperature`."
현재 상태 읽기 매핑 — 원문: "Reading current state → `AirConditionerMode` (mode) / `TargetTemperature` (setpoint)."

service_preference.when: 단순 전원 명령; SetAirPurifierMode(off)는 '모드로서의 off'로 프레이밍된 경우만
service_preference.source_quote: Prefer `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off` for bare power commands; use `SetAirPurifierMode(off)` only when the command frames it as a mode

service_preference.when: 켜기 (모드 enum에 일반 'on' 없음)
service_preference.source_quote: For turning ON, use `Switch.On` (the mode enum has no generic "on").

ko_grounding.source_quote: **Operating mode / strength** ("auto / sleep / quiet / 약하게 / 세게 / 청정모드") → `SetAirPurifierMode`.
**Power on/off** also works via the `Switch` family (an AirPurifier carries `Switch`): "켜/꺼", "turn on/off".

unstructured: 모드 enum에 off 멤버가 있어서 '공기청정기 꺼줘'를 SetAirPurifierMode(off)로도 표현 가능하다는 배경 설명 — 원문: "This mode enum DOES include an `off` member, so a plain \"turn off the air purifier\" can be expressed as `SetAirPurifierMode(off)`."

service_preference.when: 구체 수치 지정 없는 막연한 '공기질' 질의
service_preference.source_quote: if truly generic, `FineDustLevel` (PM2.5) is the conventional headline metric.

ko_grounding.source_quote: a bare "air quality / 공기질" with no specific quantity: read the pollutant the command implies; if truly generic, `FineDustLevel`

unstructured: 선택 원칙 총론 — 원문: "This is a multi-value air monitor — pick the service matching the quantity asked"

service_preference.when: 명령이 관절 각도·제스처·속도·저장 동작을 명시할 때
service_preference.source_quote: prefer these services whenever the command specifies joint angles, gestures, speed, or named trajectories.

service_preference.when: 인사/손 흔들기 제스처
service_preference.source_quote: Use this, NOT `ArmRobot.Hello`.

service_preference.when: 이동 명령에 속도가 함께 명시된 경우 (SetSpeed는 이동 없이 속도만 설정할 때)
service_preference.source_quote: If a move is commanded with a speed, pass Speed to that move instead.

ko_grounding.source_quote: **One joint to an angle → `MoveSingleAxis`** ("3번 축을 45도로", "move axis 2 to -30 degrees")
**Default speed only → `SetSpeed`** ("천천히 움직여", "속도 50으로") when the command sets a speed without also commanding a move.

ko_grounding.phrase: 이 동작을 hello로 저장 / hello 재생해 / 저장된 동작 목록
ko_grounding.source_quote: **Save a trajectory → `AddMotion`; replay → `PlayMotion`; inspect → `GetMotion`; list → `ListMotions`** ("이 동작을 hello로 저장", "hello 재생해", "저장된 동작 목록")

unstructured: 카테고리 소개 산문 — 원문: "Fine-grained motion control for the arm robot (6-axis, mycobot280-class). This is the low-level counterpart to the `ArmRobot` skill"
6축 전체 포즈 매핑 (한국어 문구 없음) — 원문: "**All six joints at once → `MoveToAngles`** (a full pose given as six angles, e.g. \"0, -15, -15, -15, -90, 0\")."
축 번호 의미 정의 — 원문: "Axis is 1-6 (1=shoulder_pan, 2=shoulder_lift, 3=elbow_flex, 4=wrist_flex, 5=wrist_roll, 6=gripper)."
기본 섹션에 있는 인자 범위 제약 (@ArgResolve와 중복 성격) — 원문: "Speed is always 1-100. RepeatCount (greet/refuse) is 1-10. Angles are degrees in [-180, 180]."

service_preference.when: 제스처(인사·손 흔들기·거절·고개 젓기) 명령
service_preference.source_quote: Gestures (greeting/waving, refusing/shaking) are handled by the `ArmRobotDetail` skill — use `ArmRobotDetail.GreetMotion` / `ArmRobotDetail.RefuseMotion`, NOT this device's `Hello`.

unstructured: 의도→서비스 매핑 (한국어 문구 없음) — 원문: "A named position (home/hello/refuse) → `SetPosition`. A raw command string → `SendCommand`. Read current position/type → `CurrentPosition`/`ArmRobotType`."
상태 읽기 매핑 (한국어 문구 없음) — 원문: "Read status → `RecordStatus` (idle/recording)."
읽기 전용 선언 — 원문: "Battery is a **read-only** capability — there are NO actions. Pick a value service for the quantity asked."

service_preference.when: 카메라 전원 켜기/끄기 (CameraState는 읽기 전용, SetCameraState 없음)
service_preference.source_quote: **Power the camera on/off via the `Switch` family** (a Camera device carries `Switch`): "카메라 켜/꺼", "turn the camera on/off" → `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`, NOT `CameraState`.

service_preference.when: 일반적인 영상/녹화 요청 기본값 (개방형 연속 녹화+명시적 중지가 아닌 한)
service_preference.source_quote: Any video/recording request (영상/녹화/녹화 시작/N초 영상) → **prefer `CaptureVideo`** (takes a `Duration` in seconds and returns a finished MP4 you can attach/send).

service_preference.when: 명시적 중지 조건이 있는 개방형 연속 녹화일 때만
service_preference.source_quote: Use `StartRecording` / `StopRecording` ONLY when the command explicitly wants open-ended continuous recording with an explicit stop (e.g. "녹화 시작했다가 ~하면 멈춰", "keep recording until…").

chaining.rule: StartRecording은 반환값이 없어 결과를 변수 할당·첨부·전송(다른 카테고리로 체이닝)할 수 없음; 녹화물을 보내거나 첨부해야 하면 반드시 CaptureVideo의 반환 MP4를 사용
chaining.source_quote: ⚠️ `StartRecording` returns NOTHING — never assign its result or attach/send it. If the recording is to be sent/attached, you MUST use `CaptureVideo`.

ko_grounding.phrase: 영상 / 녹화 / 녹화 시작 / N초 영상 / 녹화해줘
ko_grounding.source_quote: Any video/recording request (영상/녹화/녹화 시작/N초 영상) → **prefer `CaptureVideo`** … This is the default for "녹화해줘 / 녹화 시작해줘".
🛑 There is NO live-stream service. Streaming requests (스트림/라이브/streaming) cannot be fulfilled — do NOT map them to recording or capture.

unstructured: 쓰기 불가 선언 — 원문: "`CameraState` is a **read-only** value (off/on/restarting/unavailable). There is NO `SetCameraState` action — you cannot write it."

service_preference.when: 충전기 전원 켜기/끄기 (Charger.Power는 계측값이지 스위치가 아님)
service_preference.source_quote: `Charger.Power` does NOT turn anything on. To power a charger on/off use the `Switch` family (`Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`), never `Charger.Power`.

unstructured: 읽기 전용 선언 — 원문: "All Charger services are **read-only measurements** — `Power` / `Current` / `Voltage` / `ChargingState` report metering, they are NOT switches." / "Use `Charger.*` only to READ power/current/voltage/charging state."

service_preference.when: any question/request addressed to the chatbot/AI
service_preference.source_quote: The ONLY ChatProvider service is `Chat` — there is NO Send / Ask / Message / Question service.

chaining.rule: Chat의 STRING 반환값을 듣거나 보려면 Speaker.Speak($Chat) 또는 Toast로 체이닝
chaining.source_quote: when the user wants to hear/see the answer, chain it: speak `$Chat` via the Speaker / show it via Toast

chaining.rule: 체이닝 시 태그는 디바이스별 유지 — Speaker 라인에 ChatProvider 태그 재사용 금지
chaining.source_quote: Tags stay per-device when chaining: `ChatProvider.Chat` runs on the chatbot's tag and `Speaker.Speak` on the Speaker's own tag (`Speaker.Speak: (#Speaker)`) — NEVER reuse the ChatProvider tag for the Speaker line.

unstructured: 질문 텍스트는 Message에 VERBATIM으로 (한국어 유지) — 원문: "The question text goes into `Message` VERBATIM (Korean stays Korean)."
실시간 정보 질문이면 Model=gpt-5-search-api — 기본 섹션에 있는 인자 처방 규칙: "The question needs live/current information (오늘 날씨, 최신 뉴스, 지금 환율, 경기 결과) → set Model to \"gpt-5-search-api\"; otherwise \"\"."

service_preference.when: speaking / announcing / displaying the current time
service_preference.source_quote: 🛑 Do NOT pick `Clock.Time` / `Clock.Datetime` / `Clock.Timestamp` (raw string / unix forms — unnatural to speak, e.g. "1430").

service_preference.when: always
service_preference.source_quote: Do NOT use the deprecated `clock.time`/`clock.date` string built-ins.

unstructured: 시간 비교/스케줄/윈도우는 이 스테이지가 아니라 IR/cron 스테이지 소관 — 값을 말하거나 사용할 때만 Clock read를 낸다: "Time comparisons / scheduling / windows (\"오후 6시 이후\", \"until 3 PM\") are handled by the IR/cron stage via `(#Clock).Hour`/`Minute` conditions — surface a Clock read here ONLY when the command speaks/uses the value."
명명된 서브컴포넌트를 고르라는 일반 원칙: "Pick the specific sub-component the command names: ... \"what year\" → `Clock.Year`."

service_preference.when: user just wants something said out loud through a speaker
service_preference.source_quote: If the user just wants something said out loud through a speaker, use `Speaker.Speak` directly with the text; do NOT route through `TextToSpeech`.

service_preference.when: 'LLM'/'AI' appears only as the topic of the question, not a request to list models
service_preference.source_quote: The literal word "LLM" or "AI" in the question itself does NOT mean the user wants `LLMModels` — it's just the topic of the question.

chaining.rule: 이전 AI 호출의 바이너리 출력(이미지/오디오)을 파일로 저장할 때 SaveToFile로 체이닝
chaining.source_quote: Saving binary output of a previous AI call (image, audio) to a file → chain with `SaveToFile`.

chaining.rule: TextToSpeech는 오디오 파일 생성 시에만 쓰고 보통 SaveToFile과 체이닝
chaining.source_quote: Use it ONLY when the user explicitly wants an audio file produced (e.g., "generate a TTS audio file", "save speech as a wav") — typically chained with `SaveToFile`.

unstructured: 영어 표현→서비스 매핑(한국어 아님, ko_grounding 미해당): "Asking the AI a question (\"ask AI ...\", \"what is X\", \"explain X using AI\", \"Q&A\") → `ChatWithAI(Prompt)`"; "Listing/checking available models ... → `LLMModels` (value)"; "Generate / create an image → `GenerateImage`"; "Describe / explain an image → `ExplainImage`"
TextToSpeech 의미 설명: "TextToSpeech does NOT play audio. It only generates an audio binary file from text and returns it."
SpeechToText 의미 설명: "SpeechToText converts an audio file to text (file in → text out). Not a microphone listener."

service_preference.when: device is a Light and a named color is given
service_preference.source_quote: on a `Light` a named color usually goes to `Light.MoveToColor` (xy) instead — prefer that when the device is a Light

unstructured: 기본 매핑(영어): "Set a color → `SetColor` (Color is an `r|g|b` RGB string). Read current color → `Color`."

ko_grounding.phrase: 문이 열리면 / when the door opens / if the window is open
ko_grounding.source_quote: "문이 열리면 / when the door opens / if the window is open" → `Contact == false`

unstructured: 극성 고정 원칙: "The polarity is fixed and system-wide: **closed → `true`, open → `false`.**" + "Do NOT invert this. There is no separate open/close service — `Contact` is the only read."

기본 섹션에 헤딩 없는 [Mode Mapping] 블록이 있음 — 사실상 @EnumResolve 성격의 영어 enum 매핑: "\"drying mode\" / \"dry mode\" → Mode: \"drying\" (NOT \"dehumidifying\")"; "\"dehumidifying mode\" / \"active dehumidify\" → Mode: \"dehumidifying\""; "\"refresh mode\" → Mode: \"refreshing\" (NOT \"refresh\")"
기본 섹션은 Device Summary뿐이고 규칙 전부가 `# @enum_resolve` 스테이지 섹션에 있음 (헤딩이 다른 파일들의 @EnumResolve와 달리 소문자 스네이크케이스). 참고로 그 안에 잠긴/열린 한국어 매핑 존재: "locked / is locked / 잠긴 / 잠겨있는 ... → `closed`"

service_preference.when: no attachment
service_preference.source_quote: No attachment → `SendMail`.

service_preference.when: attachment is in-memory binary produced by another service ($CaptureImage / $CaptureVideo)
service_preference.source_quote: Attachment that is **in-memory binary produced by another service** (a captured image/video, e.g. `$CaptureImage` / `$CaptureVideo`) → `SendMailWithBinaryFile`

service_preference.when: attachment is a named file/path on disk
service_preference.source_quote: Attachment that is a **named file/path on disk** ("the report file", a path) → `SendMailWithFile` (File = the path).

chaining.rule: 다른 서비스의 반환 $Var(센서 읽기 등)를 Body에 체이닝해 채울 수 있음
chaining.source_quote: A `$Var` (e.g. a sensor read) can also fill the Body via chaining.

chaining.rule: 캡처 서비스의 바이너리 $Var를 SendMailWithBinaryFile의 Data 인자로 체이닝
chaining.source_quote: `SendMailWithBinaryFile` (Data = the `$Var`, Filename = a sensible name like "capture.jpg")

service_preference.when: instantaneous power draw in W is asked (vs energy over time in kWh)
service_preference.source_quote: This is ENERGY over time (kWh). For instantaneous power draw (W) use the `PowerMeter` skill instead.

unstructured: "EnergyMeter is **read-only** (cumulative energy in kWh) — no actions."

ko_grounding.source_quote: Start / stop face recognition (얼굴 인식 시작/중지) → `Start` / `End`.

unstructured: 영어 매핑(비한국어): "Register a face → `AddFace`; remove one → `DeleteFace`. Read the recognized face id → `RecognizedResult`."

service_preference.when: bare on/off (켜/꺼) with no value and the device has a Switch
service_preference.source_quote: On/off (켜/꺼, no value) → `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off` when the device has a Switch.

service_preference.when: a percentage speed value is given ("50%로", "절반")
service_preference.source_quote: `SetPercent` for a percentage ("50%로", "절반")

service_preference.when: an explicit RPM is given
service_preference.source_quote: `SetSpeed` for an explicit RPM

service_preference.when: a named strength is given (약/중/강/auto)
service_preference.source_quote: A named strength (약/중/강/auto → low/medium/high/auto) → `SetFanMode`.

unstructured: "Reading current state → the matching value service."

service_preference.prefer: type-matching GlobalVariable.Set*/Get* pair (SetInteger/GetInteger, SetDouble/GetDouble, SetString/GetString, SetBoolean/GetBoolean)
service_preference.over: Set*/Get* pairs of a mismatched type
service_preference.when: value's type: integer / decimal / text / true-false
service_preference.source_quote: Pick the **type-specific** Set/Get pair that matches the value's type: integer → `SetInteger`/`GetInteger`, decimal → `SetDouble`/`GetDouble`, text → `SetString`/`GetString`, true/false → `SetBoolean`/`GetBoolean`.

unstructured: Named persistent variables shared across scenarios.
Storing/updating a value → the `Set*` action. Reading/checking a stored value (e.g. in a condition) → the `Get*` value.
The first argument is always the variable `Name`.

service_preference.when: plain power on/off command (the mode enum has no 'off' member)
service_preference.source_quote: **Power on/off is `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`** (a Humidifier device carries the `Switch` family). For "turn on/off the humidifier", "가습기 켜/꺼" → `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`, NOT a mode change.

ko_grounding.source_quote: For "turn on/off the humidifier", "가습기 켜/꺼" → `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`, NOT a mode change.

unstructured: The mode enum is for output strength, NOT power — it has no "off" member.

service_preference.over: a leak/detected attribute on the action device (e.g., Valve, Siren)
service_preference.when: command says 'leak is detected / water leak'
service_preference.source_quote: WARNING: "leak is detected / water leak" → ALWAYS use LeakSensor.Leakage for the cond read. NEVER put a leak/detected attribute on the action device (e.g., Valve, Siren).

service_preference.when: bare on/off and the device has a Switch; otherwise fall back to MoveToLevel (ON→100, OFF→0)
service_preference.source_quote: Bare on/off → `Switch.On`/`Switch.Off` if the device has a Switch; otherwise `MoveToLevel` (ON→100, OFF→0).

chaining.rule: Relative level change chains a CurrentLevel read into MoveToLevel
chaining.source_quote: A relative change ("10 올려") reads `CurrentLevel` then `MoveToLevel`.

ko_grounding.source_quote: A level/dimming VALUE ("50으로", "밝기 30") → `MoveToLevel` (Level 0-100; Level 0 turns the device off if it supports on/off).

unstructured: Level 0 turns the device off if it supports on/off.
Read current level → `CurrentLevel`.

service_preference.when: a target value/destination is given; Move* only for continuous shifting WITHOUT a target
service_preference.source_quote: We carefully distinguish between `MoveTo*` and `Move*`. - `MoveToColor`/`MoveToColorTemperature`/`MoveToBrightness`: Reaching a target value. - `MoveColor`/`MoveColorTemperature`/`MoveHue`: Continuously shifting WITHOUT a target.

service_preference.when: ANY named color is mentioned (those alternatives need raw hue/sat numbers the user never gave)
service_preference.source_quote: 🛑 ANY named color (빨강/초록/파랑/노랑/red/green/blue…) → **ALWAYS `Light.MoveToColor`** (it reads the xy table). NEVER `MoveToHue`/`MoveToSaturation`/`MoveToHueAndSaturation`

service_preference.when: bare on/off with NO brightness value and the device has a Switch
service_preference.source_quote: **Bare on/off (켜/꺼/켜기/끄기 with NO brightness value) → ALWAYS `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off` when the device has a Switch.** ... Do NOT use `MoveToBrightness` for a plain on/off.

service_preference.when: (a) a brightness value is given, or (b) the device has NO Switch (fallback: ON→100, OFF→0)
service_preference.source_quote: `MoveToBrightness` is ONLY for: (a) a brightness value is given ("20%로", "밝기 10으로"), or (b) the device has NO Switch (fallback: ON → value 100, OFF → value 0).

service_preference.when: color temperature target given; continuous drift (no target) → the Move* variants
service_preference.source_quote: Color temperature target → `MoveToColorTemperature`; continuous drift (no target) → `MoveColorTemperature`/`MoveHue`.

chaining.rule: Relative brightness change chains a CurrentBrightness read into MoveToBrightness
chaining.source_quote: A relative change ("10 올려") reads `CurrentBrightness` then `MoveToBrightness`.

ko_grounding.source_quote: **Bare on/off (켜/꺼/켜기/끄기 with NO brightness value) → ALWAYS `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off` when the device has a Switch.**

ko_grounding.phrase: 빨강/초록/파랑/노랑 등 색 이름, 예: 초록색으로 바꿔줘

unstructured: Reading current state → the matching value service (`CurrentBrightness`, etc.).

service_preference.when: command names a specific dining location OR a meal-time (아침/점심/저녁) OR a non-today date (내일); otherwise bare 'today's menu' → TodayMenu
service_preference.source_quote: If the command names a specific dining location (e.g. `301동`, `학생식당`, building/cafeteria name) **OR** a meal-time (`아침`/`점심`/`저녁`) **OR** a non-today date (`내일`) → pick `MenuProvider.GetMenu`. Otherwise (bare "today's menu") → `MenuProvider.TodayMenu`.

ko_grounding.phrase: 내일 점심 메뉴 / 301동 오늘 점심 (location, meal-time, or non-today date)
ko_grounding.source_quote: "내일 점심 메뉴" → `GetMenu` (Command="내일 학생식당 점심"); "301동 오늘 점심" → `GetMenu` (Command="오늘 301동식당 점심").

unstructured: Argument-resolution content lives in the BASE section (heading '# GetMenu Argument (Korean string — exception)', not under @ArgResolve): `GetMenu(Command: STRING)` is a Korean structured string with format '[오늘|내일] [학생식당|수의대식당|전망대(3식당)|예술계식당(아름드리)|기숙사식당|아워홈|동원관식당(113동)|웰스토리(220동)|투굿(공대간이식당)|자하연식당|301동식당] [아침|점심|저녁]'.
Use exact Korean tokens. No English. No paraphrase.
Defaults if a slot is implicit: date→`오늘`, meal→`점심`, location→`학생식당`.
Building numbers map to closest token: `301동`→`301동식당`, `113동`→`동원관식당(113동)`, `220동`→`웰스토리(220동)`.

service_preference.when: no template id is stated (KakaoTalk needs a pre-approved template; free-form text is impossible)
service_preference.source_quote: "카톡/카카오톡 보내줘" → `SendKakaoTalk` ONLY when the command supplies a template id — KakaoTalk needs a pre-approved template, free-form text is impossible. No template id stated → use `SendSms` instead.

chaining.rule: A $Var from another category (sensor read, chatbot reply) can fill the Text argument
chaining.source_quote: A `$Var` (a sensor read, a chatbot reply) can fill `Text` via chaining.

ko_grounding.maps_to: MessageSender.SendKakaoTalk (only with a template id; otherwise SendSms)
ko_grounding.source_quote: "카톡/카카오톡 보내줘" → `SendKakaoTalk` ONLY when the command supplies a template id

unstructured: Like email: the recipient phone number and the message text are ARGUMENTS.

chaining.source_quote: → `GetNewsDigest`, then chain `$GetNewsDigest` into the notify channel (Speaker/Toast).

chaining.rule: 체이닝 시 notify Text는 반드시 다이제스트 자체($GetNewsDigest)여야 하며 고정 안내문 금지
chaining.source_quote: the notify text must be the digest itself: `Text` = `$GetNewsDigest`. NEVER a fixed announcement sentence

unstructured: 기본 섹션에 인자 규칙이 섞여 있음: 명시된 주제는 Topic에 그대로, 없으면 "" — 원문: "A stated topic (\"경제 뉴스\", \"AI 뉴스\") goes to `Topic` verbatim; no topic → \"\"."

service_preference.when: 플러그를 켜거나 끄라는 명령일 때
service_preference.source_quote: For "turn on/off the plug", "플러그 켜/꺼", pick `Switch.On` / `Switch.Off`, NEVER `Plug.Power`.

service_preference.when: 명령이 실제로 전력/전류/전압을 읽거나 확인하라고 할 때만
service_preference.source_quote: Use `Plug.*` only when the command actually asks to READ/CHECK power, current, or voltage.

unstructured: Plug 자체에는 액션 서비스가 없고 3개 모두 읽기 전용 계측값이라는 배경 설명 — 원문: "A Plug has **no action services of its own** — all three are READ-ONLY measurements"; "They are NOT switches. `Plug.Power` does NOT turn the plug on — it reports consumption."

service_preference.when: 순시 전력(W)이 아니라 기간 누적 에너지(kWh)를 물을 때
service_preference.source_quote: For accumulated energy over time (kWh) use the `EnergyMeter` skill instead.

unstructured: PowerMeter는 읽기 전용이며 액션 없음 — 원문: "PowerMeter is **read-only** (instantaneous electrical metrics) — no actions."
영어 산문 intent→service 매핑: 문서/파일/URI 인쇄 → PrintFile (Uri 필수라는 인자 규칙 포함) — 원문: "Print a document/file/URI → `PrintFile` (Uri is required; the file path/URL the command names)."

영어 산문 intent→service 매핑: 일시정지/재개 → PausePrinter/ResumePrinter, 특정 작업 취소 → CancelJob (JobId 필요) — 원문: "Pause / resume the printer → `PausePrinter` / `ResumePrinter`. Cancel a specific job → `CancelJob` (needs a JobId)."

service_preference.when: 펌프 켜기/끄기 명령이고 해당 펌프가 Switch를 가질 때
service_preference.source_quote: On/off → `Switch.On`/`Switch.Off` if the pump has a Switch.

unstructured: 영어 산문 intent→service 매핑: 모드명(normal/minimum/maximum/localSetting) 지정 → SetPumpMode, 현재 모드 읽기 → PumpMode — 원문: "A pump mode named (normal/minimum/maximum/localSetting) → `SetPumpMode`. Read current mode → `PumpMode`."

service_preference.when: 'go home/dock/charge' 또는 'pause/idle/power off' 의도일 때 (homing, charging, pause, idle, powerOff)
service_preference.source_quote: | "go home", "dock", "charge" | **RunMode** | `homing`, `charging` |

service_preference.when: 청소 방식(auto/part/repeat/manual/map) 지정 또는 'stop cleaning'일 때
service_preference.source_quote: | "stop cleaning" | **CleaningMode** | `stop` |

unstructured: enum 소속 주의 노트 (서비스 선택과 enum 해석에 걸침) — 원문: "NOTE: `stop` is a **CleaningMode** value. `homing`, `pause`, `idle` are **RunMode** values."
OperatingState는 상태 확인 전용이며 setter 없음 (Device Summary 안의 산문 규칙) — 원문: "use to CHECK status, e.g. \"is it stuck / docked / cleaning\"; there is NO setter for it"

읽기 전용 입력 장치 설명 + intent→service 매핑 + 트리거/조건 용도 노트 — 원문: "RotaryControl is a **read-only** input device (no actions). Read direction → `Rotation` (clockwise/counter_clockwise); step count → `RotationSteps`. Typically used as a trigger/condition."

service_preference.when: 사이렌을 멈추기/끄기/음소거할 때 (enum에 off류 값이 없음)
service_preference.source_quote: **Stopping / turning off / silencing** the siren → `Switch.Off` (the Switch capability). Do NOT pass `Mode=off|normal|stop` to `SetSirenMode`

service_preference.when: 사이렌이 울리고 있는지(현재 상태) 확인할 때 — SirenMode는 '어떤 모드인지' 읽을 때만
service_preference.source_quote: **Checking current state** (whether the siren is sounding) → `Switch.Switch` (boolean).

unstructured: 이 카탈로그의 Siren 기기는 Switch도 함께 가진다는 전제 설명 — 원문: "Siren devices in this catalog ALSO carry `Switch` in their category."

울리기/활성화 intent→service 매핑 (모드 인자 암시 포함) — 원문: "**Sounding / activating** the siren (any \"sound\", \"fire alarm\", \"police siren\", mode change) → `Siren.SetSirenMode` with the implied mode argument."
모드 읽기 매핑 — 원문: "**Reading what mode it is in** → `Siren.SirenMode`."
SirenMode enum에 off/normal/stop 값이 없다는 Device Summary 내 주의 산문 — 원문: "NOTE: no \"off\" / \"normal\" / \"stop\" value exists in this enum."

service_preference.when: a channel is named or no target is given at all (SendMessage is the default; empty Channel = the Thing's default channel)
service_preference.source_quote: A channel is named ("#alerts", "general 채널") or no target given → `SendMessage` (Channel = the named channel, or "" for the default).

service_preference.when: a specific user is named
service_preference.source_quote: A specific USER is named ("@john에게", "DM으로", "유저 …에게") → `SendDirectMessage`.

ko_grounding.source_quote: A channel is named ("#alerts", "general 채널") or no target given → `SendMessage`
"켜져 있으면/꺼져 있으면"(on/off state check) → `Switch` (the BOOL value), NOT an action.

unstructured: usage_note 후보 — "NOTE: A standalone Switch is rarely controlled in isolation. Most realistic commands pair it with another appliance — turn the Switch on/off as a follow-up to a Light, AirConditioner, or Humidifier state change, or read another device's state to decide whether to operate the Switch."
확인 결과: 지시문이 언급한 Light 폴백 규칙(Switch.On/Off ↔ Light.MoveToBrightness)은 이 파일에 존재하지 않음.

ko_grounding.maps_to: Switch.On / Switch.Off (다른 카테고리; TV에 Switch가 붙어 있을 때)
ko_grounding.source_quote: On/off → `Switch.On`/`Switch.Off` if the TV has a Switch.

service_preference.when: bare "알려줘" with no channel word — default visual channel unless a speaker/audio word is present
service_preference.source_quote: A bare "알려줘" with no channel word is ambiguous; treat it as a notification → `ToastPublisher.Publish` (the default visual channel) unless a speaker/audio word is present.

service_preference.when: the command names both channels
service_preference.source_quote: "스피커로 알려주고 알림도 띄워줘" / "announce … and also show a notification" names BOTH channels → emit BOTH `Speaker.Speak` and `ToastPublisher.Publish`.

ko_grounding.phrase: 알려줘 / 알림 보내줘 / 알림 띄워줘 / 표시해줘 / show / display / notify / send a notification / alert
ko_grounding.source_quote: "알려줘 / 알림 보내줘 / 알림 띄워줘 / 표시해줘 / show / display / notify / send a notification / alert" → `ToastPublisher.Publish`.

ko_grounding.phrase: 말해줘 / 읽어줘 / 스피커로 알려줘 / announce / say / read out / through the speaker
ko_grounding.source_quote: "말해줘 / 읽어줘 / 스피커로 알려줘 / announce / say / read out / through the speaker" → `Speaker.Speak`.

ko_grounding.phrase: 보여줘 / 띄워줘 / 알림(을) 띄워·보내·표시 (음성 단서 없음)
ko_grounding.source_quote: Pick it when the command asks to *show / display / notify / send an alert / pop up / 알림(을) 띄워·보내·표시* something, with no spoken-audio cue.

unstructured: usage_note 후보 — "`ToastPublisher.Publish` is the **on-screen / visual notification** channel — a toast card shown in the joi-web UI." (Speaker.Speak = spoken audio(TTS)와 채널 구분 정의)
usage_note 후보 — "One `Publish` per distinct toast. The Severity/Title/Message values are decided downstream (arg_resolve); you only pick the service."

service_preference.prefer: individual value services (Weather / TemperatureWeather / HumidityWeather / Pm10Weather / Pm25Weather / PressureWeather)
service_preference.when: the command does NOT literally contain a number for latitude AND a number for longitude — GetWeatherInfo is coordinates-only, never a fallback/default
service_preference.source_quote: ❌ If the command does NOT contain both coordinate numbers, `GetWeatherInfo` is **FORBIDDEN**. ... ❌ `GetWeatherInfo` is NOT a fallback / NOT a default / NOT a "general weather" service.

service_preference.when: the command literally contains both latitude and longitude numbers (e.g., "37.5", "127.0")
service_preference.source_quote: ✅ Use `GetWeatherInfo` **ONLY** when the command literally contains a number for latitude AND a number for longitude (e.g., "37.5", "127.0").

service_preference.when: general "weather"/"weather information" with no specific quantity named; only chain multiple values if the command explicitly lists them
service_preference.source_quote: **General "weather" / "weather information"** (no specific quantity named) → just `Weather` alone. Do NOT bundle Temperature + Humidity + others. Only chain multiple if the command explicitly lists them

ko_grounding.source_quote: 🛑 "날씨 알려줘"(general) → `Weather` ALONE. Do NOT over-fetch Temperature + Humidity + others alongside it.

unstructured: Device Summary XML의 CurrentPosition 설명 안에 표현 매핑 규칙이 내장되어 있음 (기본 섹션의 별도 Rules 아님): "'is closed' → CurrentPosition == 0; 'is open' → > 0; '30% open' → 30."
